blurb: Cat's Corner offers dance classes including swing, blues, tap, and musical theatre for all ages and levels. They host weekly social dances on Fridays with live music monthly, and community activities such as tap jams and workshops. Kids classes are available for ages 3 to 14, and childcare is offered free on live music Fridays.
